SAP Learning Hub, student edition

The guide says teams that use the Learning Hub learning have an edge. Hydra does not integrate with the Learning Hub, and no practice-system work is claimed here. In the room, name the courses you actually completed (for example the CAP or BTP developer paths) and tie each to a module above.

SAP Hackfest North Finale, SRMIST. 15 minutes in total: 10 to present, 5 for Q&A. Going over time is penalised. Theme 1: Resilient Supply Chains. Round 2 asks for a single-agent prototype and a full-system showcase with autonomous rerouting, audit logging and human approval.

Evaluation criteria and where Hydra answers them

The sensing agent is designed to read AIS, IoT sensors, IMD weather, USGS and news and hash each event into Redis, so five reports of one incident raise one alert. In this prototype the stream is simulated and deduplicated in the page; no live feeds are connected.

Event stream Simulated

Source health Simulated

Deduplication rule Production design

# Redis, 10-minute window
key = "evt:" + sha1(type|geo_cell|window)
SET key 1 NX EX 600
# OK  → forward to classifier
# nil → duplicate, drop and count

Each forwarded event gets a type, severity, location and confidence. Below 0.70 confidence it waits for a second source. Today this is a rule engine (keywords and a gazetteer) that runs as the CAP classify function; the planned upgrade is an LLM on SAP AI Core · Generative AI Hub behind the same output contract.

The impact agent finds every purchase order on the affected vessel or truck through the CAP OData service and checks its due date against the new ETA. The CAP entity mirrors the S/4HANA A_PurchaseOrderItem fields; it is not yet connected to an S/4HANA system.
